patch_description: Add regression-aware rollback to the smooth contact refinement. The soft surrogate can deliberately decrease the exact min/diameter objective while changing contact graphs, but continued deterioration often means that momentum has carried the configuration out of the strongest packing basin. The revised refinement records exact-score checkpoints more frequently. After three materially inferior checkpoints it restores the last exact-best configuration, clears momentum, damps the remaining step scale, and temporarily lowers momentum persistence. This preserves useful early basin transitions while preventing late sharpness stages from spending most iterations away from the best known exact configuration.
